scope: Checked-out current code, not attestation of deployed production. Structure-only inspection; no tests or new experiments executed by this role.

claims.allowed_claim: The inspected implementation provides strict workspace/session event envelopes and an append/read contract with monotonically assigned per-session sequence numbers and optional idempotency keys.
claims.limitation: Interface and inspected in-memory implementation only; distributed backend behavior, durability and all deployment settings are not established by inspection. Optional keys are not universal deduplication.

claims.allowed_claim: Derived model-history representations map user/model/tool events to messages, apply logged compaction, and omit audit-only events. Canonical SHA256 functions and a tap fingerprint support observability.
claims.limitation: Do not assert universal request/derive hash equality or full deterministic reexecution. The tap can emit an empty request hash after serialization failure; hashing records contents rather than attesting semantic completeness.

claims.allowed_claim: Caller resolution requires workspace, user and a forwarded bearer and rejects known Google identity-token issuers. This relies on the gateway trust boundary; it is not complete JWT/membership validation in this function.
claims.limitation: Do not claim verified tenant isolation, authentication security or penetration-test coverage from these snippets. The log user check is optional in its API.

claims.allowed_claim: The policy engine imposes a human-approval floor on declared spend-moving tools, rejects configuration below that floor, and consults workspace-scoped overrides and turn denials.
claims.limitation: The approval floor covers the declared spend-moving registry, not undiscovered side effects. Policy audit append errors are logged and do not abort the turn; universal audit completeness is not supported.

claims.allowed_claim: Approval resolution reserves a pending approval through compare-and-set lease transfer, records a resolution, holds the session guard, and reconciles a consumed claim lacking the log event. Execution rechecks declared permission and converts failures to logged error results.
claims.limitation: CAS claim admission is not exactly-once external effects. Log and lease are not one transaction, and downstream effect/crash/cancel fencing require their own tests.

claims.allowed_claim: Coded findings and model verification judgments are separate event types. Coded checks examine plans, result presence, reconciliation visibility, redactions, orientation contradictions and budget disclosure; observations and repair triggers are separately classified.
claims.limitation: A pass means these implemented rules did not find a problem, not that every factual claim is true. Evidence-present checks successful-tool existence rather than semantic claim-to-result binding.

claims.allowed_claim: Workflow invocations receive call-specific run identities and scoped working-state access, with explicit per-node retry/timeout/concurrency policies.
claims.limitation: Implementation and test availability do not prove all future graphs use scoped state, nor current production concurrency safety. The runner has an explicit nonisolated serialization path.

claims.allowed_claim: Capabilities are assembled from pack tool definitions into a shared registry; this is an implementation reuse mechanism rather than proof of identical caller authorization or all-surface behavior.
claims.limitation: Avoid frozen historical pack/tool counts; no completeness or full MCP/interactive parity inference.

claims.allowed_claim: NumberLedger stores source-specific numeric values and structured bases, named fields, counts, currency annotations and totals; it applies numeric matching, specified derivation rules, exemptions and bounded retention.
claims.limitation: Numeric support is not semantic truth; sign, entity/date/currency bindings and exemption behavior require explicit evaluation. Named/count/group state can persist differently from raw/base pools.

claims.allowed_claim: The production integrity plugin harvests structured results/session content and applies post-check cross-source derivation treatment; component explained/find_ungrounded tests do not exercise this entire path.
claims.limitation: No full-plugin, model compliance, release-gate or end-to-end accuracy claim follows from NumberLedger component measurements.
